title: FinancialMarketTickSchema
description: Baseline transaction schema for high-throughput financial market order book tick events.

sequence_id.description: Monotonically increasing 64-bit integer tick sequence identifier.

timestamp_ns.description: UTC timestamp in nanoseconds since UNIX epoch.

symbol.description: Standardized ticker symbol identifier (e.g. BTC-USD, SPY).

exchange.description: Source market exchange identifier (e.g. NASDAQ, CME, BINANCE).

bid_size.description: Top-of-book total cumulative volume available at bid price.

ask_size.description: Top-of-book total cumulative volume available at ask price.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning identifier of the emitting tick schema.
